scope: Independent gateway-core object and packet source, MVM campaign facade extraction, and final service normal-close/deadline changes. Excludes reviewer-authored transport, TUN and tests.
checked: Object facade delegates to existing raw, prepared whole-zstd and WarmSession paths; no new codec or authentication bypass. Namespace mismatch including policy/execution epochs permanently drops prepared state before exchange.

MVM caller still constructs the object facade after canonical Status probe acceptance; existing authorized frame exchange, receiver verification and RuntimeSession remain in place. Schema is provided only for Warm.

Packet decoder checks bounded header and lengths before allocations, two-fragment maximum, 64 pending entries, byte admission, TTL, duplicate/conflict handling and a connection-local 64-packet replay window. Output requires exact length, digest and IP length checks before delivery.
Packet zstd path reuses existing checked frame/content-size decoder with bounded output. Raw fallback preserves opaque or incompressible packet bytes; no cross-packet missing-base assumption.

Service normal_transport_end accepts authenticated application code0 and deadline only when configured duration has elapsed. Other transport errors remain failures. Blocking TUN write is bounded by the run deadline.
limitations: Source review is bounded to the new extraction and specified lifecycle delta, not a fresh audit of all prior codecs or MVM cryptography.
Linux cross-compilation is not execution; actual TUN behavior requires the isolated Linux witness.
Packet sequence/reassembly state is connection-local; QUIC datagram admission is not a delivery acknowledgement.
No WAN, energy, production security, CUI or FIPS qualification is implied.
